## TransferAmountNotEqualToAssetsError class

Thrown when a market repay in assets mode has `transferAmount !== amount + nativeAmount` — the pre-resolved ERC-20 pull plus the wrapped native must equal the assets repaid, so the bundle neither strands over-pulled loan tokens on `GeneralAdapter1` nor under-funds the repay.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class TransferAmountNotEqualToAssetsError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error
